description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanChargeAdjustmentCommandHandler' that handles commands for adjusting loan charges within the Fineract platform. It is annotated as a Spring service, uses Lombok for constructor generation, and implements a command handling interface to process adjustment commands by delegating to a service.

classes.name: LoanChargeAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes loan charge adjustment commands, delegating the adjustment logic to the LoanChargeWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to adjust a loan charge, and returns the result by invoking the write platform service.
